applications.title: Applications
applications.description: Every job you're pursuing, from saved to offer. Drag a card or use its menu to move or archive it.
applications.exportHint: Download every application as a spreadsheet (CSV)

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.body: Add a job you like and it starts here as Saved. Then we check your fit together and build a CV that only says what you can back up.

applications.noneInStage: No applications in {stage} match these filters.

archived.title: Nothing archived
archived.body: Archive applications you’re done with to keep the board short. They stay here and can be restored.

closed.title: No closed applications
closed.body: Rejected and withdrawn applications show up here.

applications.closedHint: Closed applications stay on the board’s Closed tile until you archive them.
applications.closedHidden: {count, plural, one {# closed application hidden.} other {# closed applications hidden.}}

application.label: Fit {value} out of 100
application.archivedBody: It’s hidden from the board and the dashboard. Restore it to work on it again.
application.fitFirst: See how well you fit, before you write anything
application.fitFirstBody: Naruvi checks each requirement of the posting against your verified facts, then picks which entries to lead with on your CV.

spontaneous.title: Spontaneous application
spontaneous.body: There’s no posting to match, so there’s no fit score. Your CV leads with your strongest verified entries, and the letter explains why you’d like to work at {company}.
spontaneous.how: Draft the CV and the letter, then send them by email to the person linked here, or note that you reached out on LinkedIn by moving the application to Sent.

documents.cvHint: Built from your verified entries, ordered for this job
documents.letterHint: Written from your facts and their site

write.title: Write your CV
write.body: No posting to match, so your CV leads with your strongest verified entries.

check.title: Check your fit
check.body: Naruvi compares each requirement with your verified facts and picks what to lead with. About a minute.

make.title: Make your CV for this job
make.body: Built from the analysis: your best-matching entries first, nothing you can’t back up.

review.title: Review your CV
review.body: Check the draft, then mark it ready.

send.title: Send your application
send.body: Apply on the posting, then mark it sent so Naruvi can remind you to follow up.

own.overdue: Overdue since {date}. Change it from Add next step above.
own.due: Due {date}. Change it from Add next step above.
own.noDate: No date yet. Add one so Naruvi can remind you.

later.closedBody: It stays here for reference. What you learned still counts: your verified facts carry over to the next application.

waiting.title: Waiting to hear back
waiting.body: Naruvi watches your inbox for their reply. No news in a week? Set a follow-up with Add next step.

interview.title: Prepare for your interview
interview.body: Go over your proven strengths and the company talking points from the fit check.

offer.title: You have an offer
offer.body: Take your time. Ask Naruvi to compare it with your other applications before you decide.

goals.intro: Tell Naruvi what you’re looking for (contract, places, work rights) and each job gets checked against it.
goals.label: Search goal check
goals.checkWhere: Check this against where you are
goals.implicitHint: Based on the location in your profile only. Add a search goal to check the contract, work mode and work rights too.

checks.contractUnknown: The posting doesn't say the contract type; you want {wanted}.
checks.noPlace: The posting gives no location; you're looking in {places}.
checks.remoteElsewhere: Remote, but the job is based in {where}. Check they hire from where you live{hasCountry, select, yes { and how a contract from {country} works for you} other {}}.
checks.permitSponsor: You'd need a permit for {country}; the posting offers sponsorship.
checks.permitNoSponsor: You'd need a permit for {country}, and they say they don't sponsor.
checks.permitUnknown: You'd need the right to work in {country}; the posting doesn't mention sponsorship.
checks.asapLate: They want someone as soon as possible; you're available from {from}.
checks.asapOk: Starts as soon as possible, which works for you.

analysis.modelReviewed: Reviewed by the language model, limited to the facts shown

verdict.offGoalFit: Your skills fit, but the job misses your search goal.
verdict.offGoalStretch: A stretch, and it misses your search goal.
verdict.strong: Strong match: you can back up most of what they ask.
verdict.worth: Worth a shot, with a few gaps to be upfront about.
verdict.stretch: A stretch for now. Go for it only if it really excites you.

method.review: Rules, then a model review ({reviewed} items checked, {changed} adjusted).
method.skipped: AI review skipped: no requirements were extracted.
method.sorted: AI sorted the posting items, then rules matched the evidence.
method.notConfigured: Rules only. Set up an AI model in Integrations for a review.

analysis.checkedAgainst: I checked it against your {count} verified facts.
analysis.howBody: A requirement is only “proven” when a fact you verified shows it. Soft skills are left to your judgement and not scored.
analysis.excludedCount: {count, plural, one {# posting item like benefits or interview steps was left out of the score.} other {# posting items like benefits or interview steps were left out of the score.}}
analysis.filterIncomplete: AI filtering was incomplete; remaining items use rule-based extraction.
analysis.talkingPoints: Talking points from their own pages
analysis.dontClaimBody: Your verified profile doesn’t back these up yet, so I’ll keep them out of your CV and letter.
analysis.requirementsBody: Each line shows the facts from your profile that back it.

empty.filtered: No candidate requirements remained after filtering. Inspect the excluded posting details below.
empty.none: No requirements were extracted. Check the imported job description and run the fit check again.

analysis.excludedBody: Interview steps, benefits and company information are kept here for transparency. They are not treated as missing skills.
analysis.leadBody: Put them first on your CV. Bars show how many requirements each one proves.
analysis.noLead: No entry proves a requirement yet.

companyResearch.read: {count, plural, one {Read # page from {company}} other {Read # pages from {company}}}
companyResearch.linked: Every item links to its source.
companyResearch.addWebsite: Add the company website on the job to improve results.
companyResearch.waiting: Reading {company}’s own website in the background. This fills in by itself in a moment.
companyResearch.intro: Read {company}’s own website (about, mission, values) and this posting to find specific, sourced reasons to mention. Nothing is invented and nothing leaves your machine except the page requests.
companyResearch.questions: Questions to answer in your own words
companyResearch.angles: Specific angles from their own words
companyResearch.nothingOn: Nothing quotable found on {site}. Check the website on the job page.
companyResearch.pagesRead: {count, plural, one {# page read} other {# pages read}}
